verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The three factors match one for one — χ_g(ξ_g) is PartitionedCovariance.cutoff radius z.1, ψ(v) is GaussianTailFlat.profile / slotCutoff, and t^h_σ is PrimaryPulseBounds.normalizedPulse, the ambient-frame homogeneous pulse of Lemma 7.4 — and localPrimaryProfile is exactly their product; componentwise this is Pulse.radialProfile (using P.x, the radial component the paper calls x) and Pulse.tangentProfile i (using P.t). The regrouping: (i) the Lean never isolates b_σ as a named field. The carrier cos(kΦ_σ) is supplied by PartitionedCovariance.wave, whose first argument is an amplitude; b_σ is wave with that argument 1, whereas the construction instantiates it as `outer * amplitude ε (mask D U q x) P.matrix T j` (PairData.radialWave/tangentWave) and as commonAmplitude (tangentMode), i.e. with a_σ and the slow mask η_β already multiplied in — precisely the two factors the paper excludes from b_σ. (ii) The Lean composes with `covered n` / a tsum over TorusInverse.Frequency, the periodization of the auxiliary rectangle, where the paper says 'extend by zero off that sign's auxiliary rectangle'; disjointness of the two signs is carried by slotSet of signedLabel U j. (iii) ψ is evaluated at the normalized slot coordinate z.2 / L (L = slot length) rather than at v. (iv) cos(kΦ_σ) appears as cos(mode·θ + phase(Y)) with mode = k·p a nonzero integer, the equality being cosine_actual_phase; in tangentMode the same carrier appears as the real part of a complex vectorMode. Each step is a rewriting, not a change of content.
